records.name: Aging and Disability Resource Centers (855-YES-ADRC)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Aging and Disability Resource Centers give free information, referrals, and help signing up for long-term services and supports. They serve people of all ages, incomes, and disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas who is older, has a disability, or is a caregiver. There is no age or income limit to get information.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Call 1-855-937-2372 (855-YES-ADRC), or search your county on the HHS Find Services page to get your local ADRC.
records.notes: ADRCs are the front door of the Texas No Wrong Door system. Local ADRC addresses and phones are in the notes of each Area Agency on Aging record.
records.description_es: Los Centros de Recursos para Personas Mayores y con Discapacidades (ADRC) dan información gratis, referencias y ayuda para inscribirse en servicios de cuidado a largo plazo. Atienden a personas de todas las edades, ingresos y discapacidades.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas que sea mayor, tenga una discapacidad o cuide a alguien. No hay límite de edad ni de ingresos para recibir información.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-855-937-2372 (855-YES-ADRC), o busque su condado en la página "Find Services" de HHS para encontrar su ADRC local.

records.name: Health Information, Counseling and Advocacy Program (HICAP)
records.organization: Texas HHS, Area Agencies on Aging, and Texas Legal Services Center
records.description_en: Free, unbiased counseling about Medicare, Medicaid, and related benefits. Counselors help you pick plans, enroll, and appeal decisions. This is Texas's State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP).
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with Medicare of any age, and their representatives. Texas Legal Services Center also gives legal help to Texans who have Medicare or are 60 or older.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-252-9240 to reach a benefits counselor through your local Area Agency on Aging.
records.notes: HHS: Medicare beneficiaries and their representatives of any age are eligible. Texas Legal Services Center (https://www.tlsc.org/hicap) gives HICAP legal advice and referrals to Texans who are Medicare beneficiaries or 60+. No single age rule is set.
records.description_es: Orientación gratis e imparcial sobre Medicare, Medicaid y otros beneficios. Los consejeros le ayudan a escoger planes, inscribirse y apelar decisiones. Es el Programa Estatal de Asistencia con Seguros Médicos (SHIP) de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con Medicare de cualquier edad y sus representantes. Texas Legal Services Center también da ayuda legal a personas de Texas con Medicare o de 60 años o más.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-800-252-9240 para hablar con un consejero de beneficios por medio de la Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores de su zona.

records.name: Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, QI-1, QDWI)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: These programs use Medicaid to help pay Medicare premiums. QMB can also pay Medicare deductibles and co-pays.
records.eligibility_summary_en: You must have Medicare Part A or Part B and low income and savings. HHS lists monthly income limits of $1,330 (QMB), $1,596 (SLMB) and under $1,796 (QI-1) for one person, and a resource limit of $9,660 for one person ($14,470 for a couple).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Apply through Your Texas Benefits online or at a benefits office. You can also call 1-800-252-9240 for free help.
records.notes: Couple monthly income limits per HHS: QMB $1,804; SLMB $1,804.01-$2,164; QI-1 $2,164-$2,435. QDWI (effective March 1, 2026): $2,660 individual / $3,607 couple, resources $4,000 / $6,000. Office finder: https://www.yourtexasbenefits.com/Screener/FindanOffice. Also check Medicare Part D Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy).
records.description_es: Estos programas usan Medicaid para ayudar a pagar las primas de Medicare. El programa QMB también puede pagar los deducibles y copagos de Medicare.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Debe tener Medicare Parte A o Parte B, y pocos ingresos y ahorros. HHS indica límites de ingreso mensual de $1,330 (QMB), $1,596 (SLMB) y menos de $1,796 (QI-1) para una persona, y un límite de bienes de $9,660 para una persona ($14,470 para una pareja).
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en Your Texas Benefits o en una oficina de beneficios. También puede llamar gratis al 1-800-252-9240 para recibir ayuda.

records.name: Texas Long-term Care Ombudsman Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission, Office of the Long-term Care Ombudsman
records.description_en: Ombudsmen protect the rights of people living in nursing homes and assisted living. They listen to concerns, explain rights, and help solve problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of nursing facilities and assisted living facilities in Texas, and their families.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of a Texas nursing or assisted living facility

records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-252-2412 to connect with an ombudsman in your area, or email ltc.ombudsman@hhs.texas.gov.
records.notes: Services are free, confidential and available statewide.
records.description_es: Los ombudsman (defensores) protegen los derechos de las personas que viven en asilos de ancianos y residencias con asistencia. Escuchan sus preocupaciones, explican sus derechos y ayudan a resolver problemas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en asilos de ancianos (nursing homes) o residencias con asistencia en Texas, y para sus familias.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-800-252-2412 para hablar con un ombudsman de su zona, o escriba a ltc.ombudsman@hhs.texas.gov.

records.name: Vocational Rehabilitation Program
records.organization: Texas Workforce Commission
records.description_en: Helps people with disabilities get ready for, find, and keep a job. Services include training, job placement, and help for students leaving school. It also has services for people 55+ who are blind.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities of all ages, including students with disabilities, who want to work.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Refer yourself online with 'Start My VR' on the TWC website, or find a local VR office with the VR office locator. Students can also ask their school's transition coordinator.
records.notes: TWC main line: 1-800-628-5115. Office locator: https://webp.twc.state.tx.us/services/VRLookup/. For disagreements, Disability Rights Texas Client Assistance Program: 1-800-252-9108.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con discapacidades a prepararse para un trabajo, encontrarlo y mantenerlo. Ofrece capacitación, colocación en empleos y ayuda para estudiantes que terminan la escuela. También tiene servicios para personas ciegas de 55 años o más.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidades de todas las edades que quieren trabajar, incluso estudiantes con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase usted mismo en línea con "Start My VR" en el sitio web de TWC, o busque una oficina local de VR con el buscador de oficinas. Los estudiantes también pueden preguntar al coordinador de transición de su escuela.

records.name: Independent Living Services
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (through local Centers for Independent Living)
records.description_en: Helps people with disabilities live in their own homes. Free services include skills training, peer counseling, and advocacy. Other help like ramps, grab bars, hearing aids, and mobility devices is on a sliding scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone with a diagnosis of a significant disability. A free assessment is available if you do not have proof of a disability.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

records.how_to_apply: Find your nearest Center for Independent Living with the HHS online search and call to set an appointment. The application appointment usually happens within 30 days.
records.cost: Core services free; purchased services on a sliding scale (usually less than 10% of cost)
records.notes: HHS says wait times average 12-18 months from first contact.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas con discapacidades a vivir en su propia casa. Los servicios gratis incluyen clases de habilidades para la vida diaria, consejería entre compañeros y defensa de derechos. Otras ayudas, como rampas, barras de apoyo, aparatos para oír y equipo para moverse, tienen un costo según sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona con un diagnóstico de discapacidad importante. Si no tiene prueba de su discapacidad, le pueden hacer una evaluación gratis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque el Centro para Vida Independiente (CIL) más cercano en el directorio en línea de HHS y llame para hacer una cita. Normalmente la cita para solicitar se da dentro de 30 días.

records.name: Specialized Telecommunications Assistance Program (STAP)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission, Office of Deaf and Hard of Hearing Services
records.description_en: Gives vouchers to buy special phones or devices for people whose disability makes it hard to use a regular phone. The voucher usually covers most of the cost.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents age 5 and older with a disability that makes it hard to use the phone, certified by an approved professional.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

documents_needed: Disability certification from an approved professional
records.how_to_apply: Fill out Form 3906 (or 3907), attach proof of residency and professional certification, and send it to STAP. Approval can take up to 6 months.
records.notes: Vouchers expire after 6 months. You can get a new voucher every 5 years.
records.description_es: Da cupones (vouchers) para comprar teléfonos o aparatos especiales a personas que, por una discapacidad, tienen dificultad para usar un teléfono normal. El cupón suele cubrir la mayor parte del costo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en Texas, de 5 años o más, con una discapacidad que les dificulta usar el teléfono, certificada por un profesional aprobado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el Formulario 3906 (o el 3907 para aparatos que generan voz), agregue prueba de que vive en Texas y la certificación de un profesional, y envíelo a STAP. La aprobación puede tardar hasta 6 meses.

records.name: Meals on Wheels Central Texas
records.organization: Meals on Wheels Central Texas
records.description_en: Delivers meals to older adults at home and serves meals at senior centers. Also offers grocery delivery, home repairs, in-home care, and friendly visits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For older adults who need help getting meals in the Austin / Central Texas area. Check with the program for exact rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call 512-476-MEAL (6325) or fill out the 'Need Meal Services?' form on the website.
records.notes: Homepage says it serves Central Texas but does not list all counties; Travis is inferred from the Austin location. Confirm other counties by phone.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas a la casa de personas mayores y sirve comidas en centros para personas mayores. También ofrece entrega de mandado, reparaciones en casa, cuidado en el hogar y visitas amistosas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores que necesitan ayuda con sus comidas en la zona de Austin y el centro de Texas. Pregunte al programa por las reglas exactas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 512-476-MEAL (6325) o llene el formulario "Need Meal Services?" en el sitio web.

records.name: Meals on Wheels San Antonio
records.organization: Meals on Wheels San Antonio
records.description_en: Brings meals to at-risk and isolated seniors at home each weekday. Also offers senior center meals, emergency shelf-stable meals, pet food, and friendly visits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homebound or isolated seniors in Bexar County and nearby counties.
records.how_to_apply: Submit a service referral on the website for yourself or someone else, or call 210-735-5115.
records.notes: Website says it serves Bexar and surrounding counties; confirm other counties by phone.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas cada día entre semana a personas mayores en riesgo o que viven solas. También ofrece comidas en centros para personas mayores, comidas de emergencia que no se echan a perder, comida para mascotas y visitas amistosas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa o que viven aisladas en el condado de Bexar y condados cercanos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Envíe una solicitud de servicio (referral) en el sitio web para usted o para otra persona, o llame al 210-735-5115.

records.name: Meals On Wheels of Tarrant County
records.organization: Meals On Wheels, Inc. of Tarrant County
records.description_en: Delivers meals at home to people who are homebound, elderly, or disabled. Also offers case management, nutrition counseling, and pet food.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For homebound, elderly, and disabled residents of Tarrant County.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Tarrant County resident

records.how_to_apply: Fill out the contact form on the website. A caseworker will contact you within 3-5 business days. You can also call 817-336-0912.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas a la casa de personas que no pueden salir, personas mayores o con discapacidades. También ofrece manejo de casos, consejería de nutrición y comida para mascotas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del condado de Tarrant que no pueden salir de casa, personas mayores o con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de contacto en el sitio web. Un trabajador de casos se comunicará con usted en 3 a 5 días hábiles. También puede llamar al 817-336-0912.

records.name: VNA Meals on Wheels
records.organization: VNA Texas (Visiting Nurse Association)
records.description_en: Delivers hot, fresh meals on weekdays to homebound seniors. Drivers also check on seniors and offer company.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents who cannot make their own meals because of illness, advanced age, or disability.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Dallas County resident

records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 689-0000 or email GETHELP@VNATEXAS.ORG.
records.notes: VNA can refer people in other North Texas counties to their local Meals on Wheels provider.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas calientes y frescas entre semana a personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa. Los repartidores también ven cómo están y les hacen compañía.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del condado de Dallas que no pueden preparar sus propias comidas por enfermedad, edad avanzada o discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 689-0000 o escriba a GETHELP@VNATEXAS.ORG.

records.name: IM Houston Meals on Wheels
records.organization: Interfaith Ministries for Greater Houston
records.description_en: Delivers healthy meals to seniors so they can stay independent at home. Some clients also get breakfast, weekend meals, and pet food.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For seniors in parts of Harris County. Ask the program about age and homebound rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call 713-533-4900 to ask about signing up.
records.notes: Page describes IM Houston being selected by the Harris County Area Agency on Aging to serve an added 17 ZIP codes south and southeast of downtown Houston (Third Ward, Sunnyside, Magnolia Park). Exact service area not listed - confirm address by phone.
records.description_es: Lleva comidas saludables a personas mayores para que puedan seguir viviendo en su casa. Algunos clientes también reciben desayuno, comidas para el fin de semana y comida para mascotas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas mayores en partes del condado de Harris. Pregunte al programa por las reglas de edad y de no poder salir de casa.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 713-533-4900 para preguntar cómo inscribirse.
